rules: Component split/merge/birth/death ends the affected geometric correspondence interval.
At the current event pose initialize its geometric representation without claiming a zero temporal edit cost.
Next pose can use that representation only after a valid geometric correspondence is established.
Unavailable prior is explicit, not a free add/delete, hidden zero, arbitrary correspondence or physical occlusion.
Physical visibility, model/camera/clip context and seek invalidation remain distinct causes.
No coefficient, temporal state implementation or selector recurrence was changed.
implementation: Offline validation contract only; product temporal state unchanged.
